settings.custom_liquid:
Get your warm and fuzzy, retro Christmas card photos taken on real film at Coastal Film Lab!

We're bringing back the charm of old-school Christmas card photos with a quick, fun photo session and plenty of nostalgic holiday vibes.

What's included

For {{ product.price | money_without_trailing_zeros }}, you'll receive:

  • 15-minute photo session
  • 12 photos shot on film
  • All your photos delivered in an online gallery
  • 6 physical 4×6 prints

Appointments are limited and expected to fill quickly. Reserve your preferred time slot before they're gone!

settings.heading: Choose your session time
settings.note: Your session is confirmed once your order is paid. Bringing a bigger group? Add back-to-back times to your cart.

settings.heading: A little holiday nostalgia
settings.content:
Whether you're coming with your partner, family, friends, or just yourself, this is a fun way to capture the holiday season.

We'll take care of the photography, film developing, and printing so you can enjoy your photos both digitally and in print.

settings.heading: When will my photos be ready?
settings.content:
Your online gallery will be ready by Wednesday, December 9. Choose your six favorites from the gallery for printing.

Your 4×6 prints will be ready for pickup within 3 business days of making your final selections.

settings.heading: Need more time?
settings.content: Each session is 15 minutes long. If you're bringing a larger group or have more photos in mind, book multiple back-to-back sessions: pick a time, add it to your cart, then come back and add the next one.
